resources.string: Shows a permanent Clear all button at the bottom of the system Recents screen. When pressed, Pixelate scrolls the carousel and activates the original system button. It does not store or transmit screen content.
Clear every recent app without hunting for the end of the carousel.
The service is running and connected
Enable the Pixelate service in Accessibility settings first.
The theme changes after saving. Other changes apply the next time Recents is opened. The service does not need to be restarted.
Follow system automatically matches Android’s light or dark appearance. Light and Dark keep the selected appearance regardless of the system setting.
Focus the button for the screen reader

Recommended for TalkBack and Jieshuo, also known as Commentary Screen Reader. After Recents opens, accessibility focus moves directly to Clear all because the button is a separate Android window. Turn this off if you prefer locating it by touch.
System button search time limit in seconds
The default is 20 seconds. A value of 0 means no limit and may consume battery if Pixel Launcher changes its behavior.
Enter a whole number of seconds.
The allowed value is in the range from 0 to 300.

Battery saving: Pixelate reacts only to window changes outside Recents. It does not scan ordinary apps, run a background loop, use the network, schedule alarms, or hold a wake lock. A small accessibility service remains in memory so the button can appear immediately.

1. Enable Pixelate in Accessibility settings.

2. Open the Recents screen normally.

3. If recent apps exist, a Clear all button appears at the bottom. It stays hidden when the list is empty.

4. Press the button. Pixelate scrolls the carousel and activates the system Clear all action.
Pixelate works entirely on your device, has no Internet access, and sends nothing. It reacts only to window changes and inspects Pixel Launcher structure exclusively on the Recents screen.
A smiling pixel face – the Pixelate icon
Pixelate supports only physical Google Pixel devices with Pixel Launcher. It will not run on this device. Detected device: %1$s %2$s.
